detailed_description: Fake Data Generator creates small browser-side test datasets from editable field definitions. Choose a row count from 1 to 1000, select a locale, add or remove fields, name each column, and choose field types such as name, first name, last name, email, phone, address, city, country, company, job title, date, number, UUID, URL, or username. After generating data, you can preview the first rows, edit visible cells inline, copy the JSON output, or export the dataset as JSON, CSV, or SQL using the table name field.
usage_steps: Set the number of rows you want to generate.
Choose the locale used for the built-in sample names and places.
Add, remove, rename, and configure fields with the available field type dropdowns.
Optionally set a table name for SQL export.
Click Generate to create the dataset and preview the first rows.
Copy the generated JSON or export the data as JSON, CSV, or SQL.
usage_examples: Create sample users with name, email, phone, and username columns for a UI mockup.
Generate a small CSV of companies, cities, and countries for spreadsheet testing.
Export SQL insert statements for a simple demo table.
Edit a generated preview cell before copying the JSON for a fixture.
